newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE TOP $106/DRESSED, UP $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE TOP $106/DRESSED, UP $1 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis, not well tested on a live basis, USDA said. Demand and seller interest continued good.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs - few 65.00; dressed basis 105.50-106.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs - few 65.00; dressed basis 105.00-106.00. Sales confirmed - 5,000 For the week - 71,700
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
